name: pulse-monorepo
description: Developer uptime and heartbeat monitoring service

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,worker,web" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
